🕵️ rebrowser-bot-detector
Modern tests to detect automated browser behavior. See github repo for more details. How to properly run the tests?
Test name	Time since load	Notes
⚪️ dummyFn	1 ms	Call window.dummyFn() to test if you can access main world objects.
⚪️ sourceUrlLeak	1 ms	Call document.getElementById('detections-json') to test sourceUrl leak.
⚪️ mainWorldExecution	2 ms	Call document.getElementsByClassName('div') to trigger this test. If you did and the test wasn't triggered, then you're running it in an isolated world, which is safe and not detectable.
🟢 runtimeEnableLeak	2 ms	No leak detected.
⚪️ exposeFunctionLeak	3 ms	No window.exposedFn. Use page.exposeFunction to trigger this test.
🟢 navigatorWebdriver	3 ms	No webdriver presented.
🟢 viewport	9 ms	Viewport is different from default values used in automation libraries.

}

🟢 pwInitScripts	9 ms	No window.__pwInitScripts detected.
🟢 bypassCsp	17 ms	Content Security Policy (CSP) is enabled, it's expected behavior.
